state.model: LocalLedger: three actors start with 1000 free units each and zero deposits. Deposit moves free to deposited; withdraw reverses it. Excess amounts revert without changing state. No fees or external assets.
state.goal: Exercise diverse valid accounting transitions and input boundaries. Prefix is syntax only: actual balances and fuzzed operands are unknown until Forge executes the program.

action.instructions: Select a useful action production for the next action. Your siblings are selected independently; do not assume their answers.

criteria.deposit: Move free balance into the deposit.
criteria.withdraw: Move deposited balance back into free balance.

amount.instructions: Select a useful amount production for the next action. Your siblings are selected independently; do not assume their answers.

criteria.uint: A uint256 argument generated by Forge at runtime.
criteria.balance: Read ledger.balanceOf(address) immediately before this action.
criteria.deposited: Read ledger.depositedBalanceOf(address) immediately before this action.

address.instructions: Select a useful address production for the next action. Your siblings are selected independently; do not assume their answers.

criteria.bytes20: An arbitrary bytes20 argument generated by Forge.

sender.instructions: Select a useful sender production for the next action. Your siblings are selected independently; do not assume their answers.
